title: Call Copilot
tagline: Live retrieval-grounded suggestions for sales engineers, powered by TiDB hybrid search
pattern: sales engineers and account executives who want real-time help on live calls: the right product fact, proof point, or discovery question at the right moment

metrics.label: Speech-end to transcript latency
metrics.howMeasured: receivedAtMs - (turnStartedAtMs + lastWord.end) per finalized AssemblyAI Turn message

metrics.label: Vector search p50
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(vectorLatencySamples).p50 from timed() around VEC_COSINE_DISTANCE query

metrics.label: Vector search p99
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(vectorLatencySamples).p99 from timed() around VEC_COSINE_DISTANCE query

metrics.label: Full-text search p50
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(fulltextLatencySamples).p50 from timed() around FTS_MATCH_WORD query

metrics.label: Full-text search p99
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(fulltextLatencySamples).p99 from timed() around FTS_MATCH_WORD query

metrics.label: Hybrid retrieval p50
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(hybridLatencySamples).p50 from timed() around Promise.all([vector, fulltext]) + reciprocalRankFusion

metrics.label: Hybrid retrieval p99
metrics.howMeasured: summarize(hybridLatencySamples).p99 from timed() around Promise.all([vector, fulltext]) + reciprocalRankFusion

metrics.label: Claude time to first token
metrics.howMeasured: firstDeltaMs - requestSentMs, first content_block_delta with delta.type text_delta

metrics.label: End-to-end suggestion latency
metrics.howMeasured: firstDeltaMs - utteranceEndMs, utterance end from the triggering ASR Turn, firstDeltaMs from the Claude stream

metrics.label: Suggestions shown
metrics.howMeasured: cumulative count incremented on each Claude suggestion stream's message_stop event

metrics.label: Suggestions accepted
metrics.howMeasured: cumulative count incremented on each accept-suggestion control event

phases.label: Consent
phases.narration: Before anything is captured, the copilot announces recording and waits for consent - that gate is not optional.

phases.label: Discovery
phases.narration: The SE and prospect are just talking. Nothing fires until the copilot recognizes something worth surfacing.

phases.label: Discovery question asked
phases.narration: A direct question just fired the trigger. Watch the suggestion card - TiDB found the fact, Claude worded it, in about a second.

phases.label: Competitor named
phases.narration: The moment a competitor's name is said, the retrieval scope shifts to battlecard content automatically.

phases.label: Objection raised
phases.narration: This is the objection most SEs get asked and fumble - the copilot has the honest answer queued in under two seconds.

phases.label: Technical term used
phases.narration: A technical term triggers a documentation-grounded answer, not a guess.

phases.label: Call ends, summary written
phases.narration: When the call ends, the copilot writes the summary and follow-up back to the same TiDB store - no separate CRM sync step.

checks.label: Consent recorded before capture
checks.description: Passes if the consent log line is written before the first audio chunk reaches ASR.

checks.label: No raw audio persisted
checks.description: Passes if no .wav/.pcm/.raw file exists under demos/call-copilot/ outside fixtures/ after the run.

checks.label: Hybrid retrieval matches the labeled eval set
checks.description: Passes if hybrid retrieval's top result matches the expected fact id for every row in test/eval/triggers.json.

checks.label: Suggestion latency under target
checks.description: Passes if the run's p99 suggestion-latency-ms is at or under SUGGESTION_LATENCY_TARGET_MS.

controls.label: Start mock call
controls.description: Begins streaming the mock-call audio into the ASR pipeline and advances to the discovery phase.

controls.label: Inject objection
controls.description: Forces the objection trigger to fire immediately with the scripted objection line.

controls.label: Toggle retrieval mode
controls.description: Cycles the next retrieval through vector, fulltext, then hybrid.
